d: America built its economic and technological dominance by attracting talent from across the world. Indian engineers, entrepreneurs and tech professionals helped power Silicon Valley, build global companies and drive innovation. But under Donald Trump, tougher H-1B visa rules, rising costs and growing immigration uncertainty are forcing many to reconsider their American dream. Thousands are returning to India, while others are exploring opportunities in the UK, Canada and Europe. From workers facing a 60-day deadline after losing their jobs to the story of NVIDIA co-founder Jensen Huang,…
